cases.actual_cause: DataNode DataXceiver encountered exceptions while serving blocks to peer nodes; the logs do not include the underlying exception details.
cases.verdict: DataNode DataXceiver components repeatedly failed to serve blocks to peers, generating WARN logs; the failures occurred many times across the cluster but the underlying exception details are not present in the sampled logs.

cases.actual_cause: SendWorker threads are repeatedly terminating, likely due to interruptions or resource constraints in the QuorumCnxManager send worker component.
cases.verdict: The logs show a frequent pattern of SendWorker threads exiting unexpectedly, with 262 WARN entries of "Send worker leaving thread" across many timestamps, indicating repeated interruptions or failures in the send worker component. Additionally, a single ERROR entry records an unexpected exception in CommitProcessor, but the underlying cause is not detailed in the logs.

cases.actual_cause: mod_jk workerEnv processes are failing to initialize or are being killed, leading to child workers not being found in the scoreboard and repeated error state entries
cases.verdict: mod_jk workerEnv processes are repeatedly entering an error state, causing child workers to fail to initialize or be missing from the scoreboard; this occurs hundreds of times across the log.

cases.actual_cause: Repeated SSH authentication failures due to automated login attempts (brute force) from ip_20 and ip_11, causing the server to disconnect clients after exhausting authentication methods.
cases.verdict: The SSH service is experiencing a high volume of failed authentication attempts from IP addresses ip_20 and ip_11, leading to many disconnects and a spike in error logs.

cases.actual_cause: multiply function returns incorrect result for inputs 3 and 4
cases.verdict: The test suite ran 5 tests, but test_multiply failed because multiply(3,4) returned 11 instead of 12; the failure is isolated to that test.

cases.actual_cause: pip install process was killed, likely due to out‑of‑memory or resource limits
cases.verdict: During the Docker build, the pip install step was killed (exit code 137), causing the build to fail. This occurred once in the 13 lines sampled.

cases.actual_cause: Incompatible peer dependency between react@18.2.0 (root) and react-dom@17.0.2 which requires react ^17.0.0, leading npm to abort the install with an ERESOLVE error
cases.verdict: npm install failed due to a peer dependency conflict: the root project uses react@18.2.0 while react-dom@17.0.2 requires react ^17.0.0, causing npm to emit an ERESOLVE error on most lines.

cases.actual_cause: Disk space exhaustion on /home/runner/.npm/_cacache during npm install/build
cases.verdict: The build failed because the runner ran out of disk space while writing npm cache artifacts, causing an ENOSPC error and a shutdown signal.
